svg.title: ReBuilt v2.0 — First-run prompt (FIRST TIME USING THE APP?)
svg.desc: Draggable navy modal card asking whether this is the user's first time, with No-skip (secondary) and Yes-show-me (primary teal) buttons, a grabber bar below for repositioning in AR, and the hover state shown on the primary button.
